chapter.verse: Tua hi a, Khris sungah thapiakna khatpeuh, itna pan noptuamna khatpeuh, Kha sungah kikholhkhopna khatpeuh, lainatna leh thukhualna khatpeuh om ahihleh
khatlekhat ki-itna, khatlekhat kithuhualna, leh lungtup kibatna cihte-a kipan lungsim kikhatna tawh keima' lungdamna hong cingtaaksak un.
Angsung theihna leh kisialhnopna pong tawh bangmah hih kei unla kiniamkhiatna tawh note sangin midangte thupizaw ci-in ngaihsun un.
Note khat ciat nomau' aituam vai bek kin kei unla, a dangte' vai zong kinbawl un.
Note khatlekhat kikal ah Khris Jesu' neih lungsim puakzia na nei un.
Jesu Khris in Pasian' limlemel nei napi Pasian tawh kikimna tuhkhiat ding namin ngaihsun lo a,
sila limlemel hong lakna, mihingte tawh mel kivalak dingin hong suahna, mihing melsuah hong puakna cih teng tawh amahmah kihawmsuaksak hi.
Amahmah kiniamkhiattawm a, sihna—singlamteh tunga sihna tanghial—a tuah dongin thumang hi.
Tua hangin Pasian in a lianpen dinmun ah amah koih a, min khempeuh sangin a sangzaw min guan hi.
Vantunga omte, lei maitang tunga omte, lei maitang nuai-a omte a vekpi-un Jesu' min nuai-ah khukdin ding uh a,
leii khempeuh in Jesu Khris pen Topa hi ci-in Pa Pasian' minpha kilangsak ding uh hi.
Tua ahih manin kong itte aw, thumang den na hih mah bangun tu-in zong kei' om ciang bek hilo-in kei' om loh hunte phadiak ah na hotkhiatna uh launa linna tawh na semkhia un.
A hang pen ama' hong deihsak bangin na tup na sep nadingun note' sunga hong gamtang pen Pasian ahi hi.
Na khempeuh phun lo nial lo-in sem unla
a lungkawi leh a lampial khangmite' laizang ah sitbaanglo Pasian' tate hi-in paubaanglo leh mawhbaanglo na hih nadingun, leh van-awngthawl sunga aksite bangin a taang na hih nadingun,
nuntakna thu na mitsuan un. Tua hileh Khris ni hong tun ciangin kei a mawk tai hilo, a mawk sep hilo ci-in ka kipak thei ding hi.
Note' upna hanga kibawl biakpiakna leh siampi nasepna ah lengtui biakpiak van bangin kei hong kisungkhia himah taleh nuamin note na vekun kong lungdampih hi.
Tua mah bangin note zong nuam unla kei hong lungdampih un.
Note' thu ka zakna tawh ka lungnop nadingin note' kiangah Timothy hong paisak baih thei dingin Topa Jesu sungah ka kilamen hi.
A hang pen hih takah amah bangin note hong lunghimawh ding taktak kuamah dang om lo hi.
Amaute a vekun Jesu Khris' ading ci lo-in angsung phattuam ding bek zong uh hi.
Timothy ahihleh a ginatna na theih uh hi a, a pa tawh a semkhawm tapa khat bangin Lungdamna Thu zekkhiatna ah kei tawh hong semkhawm hi.
Tua hangin ka dinmun thu-omzia bangci ding cih ka theih khit phetin amah hong paisak thei dingin ka kilamen hi.
A sawt lo-in keimahmah hong pai thei dingin zong Topa' sungah ka kilungmuang hi.
Ka sanggampih, naseppih leh galdopih, note' kamtai leh ka kitangsapna ah hong huhpa ahi Epaphroditus note' kiang kong paisak ding kisam ka sa hi.
Amah cina ci-in na zak uh pen amah lungnuam het lo a, note na vekun hong mu nuam mahmah hi.
A hang pen si dektak zah dongin amah cina takpi hi. Ahi zongin Pasian in amah khual ahih manin—amah bek hilo, kei zong hong khual ahih manin—ka dahna khat tungah khat a hong kithuap lo ahi hi.
Tua hangin amah mukha kikin na lungnop nadingun leh keima' dahna a kiam nadingin amah kong paisak ding ka kin semsem hi.
Tua ahih manin Topa' sungah nakpi lungdamna tawh amah na sang unla, tua bang mite na thupibawl un.
A hang pen Khris' ading nasepna ah amah a si dektak hi a, kei nong donna uhah a kitangsam laite amah in nuntakna luangkhamin hong dipsak hi.
